shortDescription: Manage individual Firewall Schedule Time Ranges.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: day
options.description: The day for each specified `month` value. Each value specified must correspond with a `month` field value and must match the order exactly. For example, a `month` value of `[3, 6]` and a `day` value of `[2, 17]` would evaluate to March 2nd and June 17th respectively.

options.name: hour
options.description: The start time and end time for this time range in 24-hour format (i.e. HH:MM-HH:MM).

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: month
options.description: The month for each specified `day` value. Each value specified must correspond with a `day` field value and must match the order exactly. For example, a `month` value of `[3, 6]` and a `day` value of `[2, 17]` would evaluate to March 2nd and June 17th respectively.

options.name: parent_lookup_query
options.description: A dictionary of query parameters used to look up the parent Firewall Schedule. This should contain field name/value pairs that uniquely identify the parent object this resource is nested under.

options.name: position
options.description: The day of the week this schedule should be active for. Use `1` for every Monday, `2` for every Tuesday, `3` for every Wednesday, `4` for every Thursday, `5` for every Friday, `6` for every Saturday, or `7` for every Sunday. If this field has a value specified, the `month` and `day` fields will be unavailable.

options.name: rangedescr
options.description: A description detailing this firewall schedule time range's purpose.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
